title: Animate ggplot2 Plots with Anime.js
text: gganime renders ggplot2 plot written gganimate syntax animated SVG. output self-contained HTML widget powered Anime.js (animejs package), instead GIF video. animation single SVG timeline attributes: stays sharp size, since marks vectors rather raster fixed pixels; file holds one copy scene plus per-element keyframes, one image per frame; plays browser scrub bar, reader can pause step frames.

title: Animate ggplot2 Plots with Anime.js
text: Write plot exactly gganimate, call anime() instead animate(). shadow_mark() leaves earlier frames behind current one: anime() returns htmlwidget, prints RStudio Viewer, embeds R Markdown Quarto, saves htmlwidgets::saveWidget(). Loading gganime also makes bare gganimate plot print anime() console; set options(gganime.autoprint = FALSE) keep gganimate’s output. Shiny, use gganimeOutput() renderGganime().
code: library(ggplot2) library(gganimate) library(gganime)  p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +   geom_point(size = 3) +   transition_states(gear, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1) +   labs(title = "Gear: {closest_state}")  anime(p) p <- ggplot(airquality, aes(Day, Temp)) +   geom_point() +   transition_time(Month) +   shadow_mark(colour = "grey70") +   labs(title = "Month: {frame_time}")  anime(p)

title: Animate ggplot2 Plots with Anime.js
text: Transitions: transition_states(), transition_time(), transition_reveal(). Geoms: points, lines paths, bars columns, areas ribbons. enter_*() / exit_*(), ease_aes(), per-frame labels title, subtitle, caption. shadow_mark(). Anything else stops message naming alternative. Current limits include faceted plots (single panel renders), non-Cartesian coordinate systems, shadow_wake() / shadow_trail(), view_*() view_static().

text: bare gganimate plot now prints animated-SVG widget anime() console knitr.
